name: Christian "quaddi" Dameff MD MS
biography: Christian (quaddi) Dameff is an emergency medicine physician, former open capture the flag champion, prior DEF CON speaker, and researcher. Published works include topics such as therapeutic hypothermia after cardiac arrest, novel drug targets for myocardial infarction patients, and other Emergency Medicine related works with an emphasis on CPR optimization. Security research topics including hacking critical healthcare infrastructure and medical devices. This is his thirteenth DEF CON. @cdameffMD
